'''Bie Breil'lya''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] of [[Clan Alya]] and first cousin of [[Tav Breil'lya]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Breil'lya was captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Andov Syn|Nariss Siv Loqesh]], who planned to use the Bothan as bait to trap other hunters seeking the bounty.
